_comment: Org priority for creation flows. Copy this file to orgs.json and set your own orgs. orgs.json is git-ignored so your real org names stay private; this example ships in the repo. 'order' pins org sort order in pickers (others fall back to alphabetical with 'personal' always last); 'default' is the fallback org when a flow is invoked without one. 'personal' is a normal org and can stay here.
